text: `KnowledgeRecord` represents repo, folder, file, symbol, route, concept, service, store, and environment knowledge with a replaceable current block, append-only dated notes, append-only update history, source fingerprint, revision token, retirement, and supersession metadata while parsing legacy note files unchanged.

text: Symbol records resolve to `.reggie/notes/_symbols/<source-path>/<qualified-symbol>.md`; routes and concepts remain below `_entities`, and all target resolution rejects traversal or ambiguous IDs.
note: Symbol and digest-backed entity routing are verified.
head: 6384b88e689758ab7fc29c4acab3fac968aca75d

text: Fingerprints come from the indexed source or entity evidence, changed fingerprints mark current prose stale, and no stale record refreshes without an explicit edit or generation request.
note: Source fingerprints and explicit stale behavior are verified.
head: 6384b88e689758ab7fc29c4acab3fac968aca75d

text: Normal narration, search, context, MCP, server reads, and generated agent instructions use only non-retired current text while history and retired or superseded text remain explicitly retrievable.

head: 6384b88e689758ab7fc29c4acab3fac968aca75d

text: A validated human or AI update can replace current text, and every update appends agent/author, code revision, changed fields, reason, timestamp, and prior revision without altering earlier history.
note: Human and agent replacements append immutable attribution history.
head: 6384b88e689758ab7fc29c4acab3fac968aca75d

text: Inline saves and retirement writes use expected revisions, atomic replacement, a shared knowledge lock, the configured integration checkout, and exactly one knowledge-only Git commit without including or unstaging unrelated working-tree or index changes.
note: Inline and retirement commits preserve unrelated Git state under lock and revision guards.
head: 6384b88e689758ab7fc29c4acab3fac968aca75d

text: A confirmed batch validates all generator output before publishing, writes one atomic knowledge batch, creates exactly one knowledge-only commit, exposes the resulting commit, and leaves no partial current updates when a chunk fails.

head: 6384b88e689758ab7fc29c4acab3fac968aca75d

text: Codex and Claude adapters run with read-only permissions, bounded source context, timeouts, and a strict shared output schema that rejects malformed, hostile, extra-entity, or over-sized responses.

head: 6384b88e689758ab7fc29c4acab3fac968aca75d

text: Batch and incremental jobs expose selected agent, new/stale entities, file/symbol counts, expected chunks, progress, failures, resumability, confirmation state, and resulting commit; the last selected agent and job state remain local and uncommitted.
